name: panda-breath
title: Panda Breath
author: bespoked
description: Drives a BIQU Panda Breath chamber-heating device as a standard Klipper heater. Adds Klipper extras (panda_breath.py and its guard) that talk to the Panda Breath over its OEM WebSocket protocol, plus a [heater_generic] so you control chamber heat from the web UI and slicer like any other heater, with M141/M191, device alarms as Klipper errors, and a watchdog that switches the device off when Klipper or the link fails. Point it at your Panda Breath's host. The Panda Breath hardware is separate.
tagline: Chamber heating with a BIQU Panda Breath, as a Klipper heater.

variables.name: PANDA_HOST
variables.description: Hostname or IP of the Panda Breath device

variables.name: USE_U1_CAVITY_THERMOMETER
variables.description: Snapmaker U1 only: M191 also goes on when the U1 cavity thermometer reaches the target (true) or waits for the Panda Breath only (false)

config.label: Panda Breath host
config.hint: Hostname or IP of the Panda Breath. If .local does not resolve, use the IP.

config.label: Also use the U1 cavity thermometer
config.hint: Snapmaker U1 only. On: M191 goes on as soon as the Panda Breath or the U1 cavity thermometer reaches the target, whichever is first. Off: only the Panda Breath counts.
